en.name: Madeln Castle Ruins
en.text: Located high above Pratteln, the ruins of Madeln Castle offer hikers an insight into the medieval fortification culture of the region.

en.name: St. Leodegar Reformed Church
en.text: The prominent village church with its late Gothic tower shapes the historic skyline and is a key part of the local heritage.

en.name: KUSPO Cultural Centre
en.text: The Culture and Sports Center is the modern hub for community events and features an architecturally interesting design.

en.name: water reservoir

en.text: The playground on Wyhlenstrasse in Pratteln offers children plenty of space to romp and play.

en.name: Robinsonspielplatz Pratteln
en.text: The Robinson playground in Pratteln invites children to creative play and adventures.

en.name: Liebrüti
en.text: The Liebrüti playground in Pratteln is a nice meeting point for families with children.

en.name: Aquabasilea
en.text: A large water park in Pratteln with numerous slides and wellness areas for the whole family.

en.name: Ysebähnli am Rhy
en.text: A family-friendly theme park in Pratteln offering fun and entertainment for children.

en.text: A zoo in Pratteln that serves as an interesting excursion destination for families and nature lovers.

en.name: Museum Augusta Raurica
en.text: The Augusta Raurica Museum in Pratteln displays significant finds from the ancient Roman city. Visitors can experience the daily life of the Romans through original exhibits.

en.name: Augusta Raurica
en.text: Augusta Raurica is one of the best-preserved Roman archaeological sites north of the Alps. The extensive area includes an ancient theater, forums, and detailed reconstructions.

en.name: Kabelbruecke Wyhlen
en.text: The Wyhlen cable bridge near Pratteln is part of the infrastructure of the dam on the Rhine. It connects the riverbanks and is closely linked to the industrial history of the region.

en.name: Neu-Schauenburg
en.text: Neu-Schauenburg is a castle ruin near Pratteln that serves today as a testament to medieval fortification art. The site is idyllically situated in the landscape and is accessible via hiking trails.

en.name: Augst Amphitheatre
en.text: The Augst Amphitheatre is an impressive structure of the ancient city of Augusta Raurica. It is still used for cultural events today, bringing Roman history to life.

en.name: Röm.-kath. Kirche
en.text: The Roman Catholic Church in Pratteln is a central place for worship and reflection. The building blends harmoniously into the modern townscape of the community.

en.name: Wehrbrücke Augst/Wyhlen
en.text: The Augst/Wyhlen weir bridge spans the Rhine and serves for water regulation for the local power station. It connects Switzerland with Germany and is a technical monument.

en.name: Computermuseum beider Basel
en.text: The Computer Museum of both Basels in Pratteln presents the rapid development of information technology. The collection includes historical computers and rare hardware from past decades.

en.name: Ortsmuseum
en.text: The Pratteln local museum is dedicated to the history and tradition of the community. It displays exhibits related to rural and craft life in former times.

en.name: Kästeli
en.text: Kästeli is part of the Augusta Raurica archaeological ensemble in Pratteln. The area houses important findings that provide valuable insights into the Roman colony.

en.name: Roman Aqueduct
en.text: This Roman aqueduct near Pratteln is a relic of the ancient water supply of Augusta Raurica. It illustrates the highly developed engineering skills of the Romans in this region.

en.name: Schmelzwassersedimente Wyhlen
en.text: The meltwater sediments near Wyhlen are a significant geological and archaeological site. They document the glacial landscape development and offer insights into early earth layers.

en.name: Römische Kloake (Zugang zum Abwasserkanal)
en.text: The Roman sewer in Pratteln is a rare access point to the ancient drainage system of the city of Augusta Raurica. This monument illustrates the advanced urban hygiene of the Roman era.

en.name: Temple on Schönbühl hill
en.text: The Temple on Schönbühl hill is a prominent archaeological site within Augusta Raurica. The foundations bear witness to the religious significance of this location in the ancient settlement.

en.name: Grienmatt Sanctuary
en.text: The Grienmatt Sanctuary is an archaeological site in Pratteln belonging to the Roman city of Augusta Raurica. It includes remains of ancient cult buildings documenting the religious daily life of the Romans.

en.name: Forum und Forumtempel
en.text: The forum and forum temple formed the administrative and religious center of the Roman city of Augusta Raurica. Today, the excavated remains provide a vivid picture of public life in antiquity.

en.name: Curia
en.text: The Curia was the meeting place of the city council in Augusta Raurica near Pratteln. The archaeological remains show the place where political decisions for the Roman colony were made.

en.name: römisches Handels- und Gewerbehaus
en.text: This Roman commercial and industrial building in Pratteln shows the economic structure of Augusta Raurica. It provides insights into the ancient workshops and salesrooms of the settlement.

en.name: Badeanlage und Brunnenhaus
en.text: The ancient bathing complex and fountain house are significant archaeological testimonies of Roman water culture in Pratteln. They illustrate the high importance of hygiene and water supply in Augusta Raurica.

en.name: Stadtmauer Augusta Raurica
en.text: The city wall of Augusta Raurica served as protection for the ancient Roman settlement near Pratteln. Today, parts of the fortification that once bounded the city area can be visited.

en.name: Hülftenschanz
en.text: The Hülftenschanz near Pratteln is a historical monument reminding of warlike events in regional history. The preserved earthworks are a testament to former fortification systems.

en.name: Gallorömischer Vierecktempel
en.text: The Gallo-Roman rectangular temple in Pratteln is a significant ruin from the era of Roman settlement. It shows the architectural fusion of local and Roman cult elements.

descriptionAdvanced.de: Pratteln liegt im Ergolztal östlich von Basel und markiert den Übergang zwischen der städtischen Agglomeration und der ländlichen Umgebung des Tafeljuras. Die Gemeinde blickt auf eine beeindruckende industrielle Entwicklung zurück, die durch den frühen Anschluss an das Eisenbahnnetz und die Ausbeutung der Salzvorkommen in den Rheinsalinen befeuert wurde. Im historischen Dorfkern thront das Schloss Pratteln, ein stattlicher Herrensitz aus dem 13. Jahrhundert, der heute als Wahrzeichen und Kulturstätte dient. Ein weiterer wirtschaftlicher Eckpfeiler ist die Logistik und Schwerindustrie, wobei Pratteln als strategisch wichtiger Verkehrsknotenpunkt im Dreiländereck fungiert. Die Z7 Concert Factory hat Pratteln international als Mekka für Rock- und Heavy-Metal-Konzerte bekannt gemacht und zieht Fans aus ganz Europa an. Trotz der starken baulichen Entwicklung hat die Gemeinde grüne Lungen wie den Lörzbach und die bewaldeten Hügel des Adlersbergs bewahrt. Die römische Vergangenheit der Region wird in der nahegelegenen Ausgrabungsstätte Augusta Raurica lebendig, die teilweise auf Prattler Gemeindegebiet liegt. In den letzten Jahrzehnten hat sich das Stadtbild durch moderne Hochhäuser und neue Wohnquartiere stark gewandelt, was Pratteln zu einem vielseitigen und urbanen Lebensraum macht. Die soziale Vielfalt und das aktive Vereinsleben tragen massgeblich zur hohen Identifikation der Bewohner mit ihrem Wohnort bei.
descriptionAdvanced.hu: Pratteln az Ergolz-völgyben fekszik, Bázeltől keletre, és a városi agglomeráció, valamint a Tafeljura vidéki környezete közötti átmenetet jelöli. A közösség lenyűgöző ipari fejlődésre tekint vissza, amelyet a vasúthálózathoz való korai csatlakozás és a rajnai sólepárlók sókészleteinek kiaknázása segített elő. A történelmi falu központjában áll a prattelni kastély, egy 13. századi impozáns kúria, amely ma jelképként és kulturális helyszínként szolgál. További gazdasági alappillér a logisztika és a nehézipar, mivel Pratteln stratégiailag fontos közlekedési csomópont a hármashatárnál. A Z7 Concert Factory nemzetközi hírnevet szerzett Prattelnnek a rock- és heavy metal koncertek mekkájaként, Európa minden tájáról vonzva a rajongókat. Az intenzív beépítés ellenére a közösség megőrizte zöld területeit, mint például a Lörzbachot és az Adlersberg erdős dombjait. A régió római kori múltja a közeli Augusta Raurica ásatási területen kel életre, amely részben Pratteln területén fekszik. Az elmúlt évtizedekben a városképet jelentősen megváltoztatták a modern toronyházak és az új lakónegyedek, ami Prattelnt sokoldalú és városi élettérré tette. A társadalmi sokszínűség és az aktív egyesületi élet jelentősen hozzájárul ahhoz, hogy a lakók erősen kötődnek lakóhelyükhöz.
descriptionAdvanced.ro: Pratteln este situat în valea Ergolz, la est de Basel, marcând tranziția între aglomerația urbană și mediul rural al regiunii Tafeljura. Comuna are o istorie industrială impresionantă, stimulată de conectarea timpurie la rețeaua feroviară și exploatarea zăcămintelor de sare din salinele Rinului. În centrul istoric al satului se află Castelul Pratteln, un conac impunător din secolul al XIII-lea, care servește astăzi drept simbol și loc de desfășurare a evenimentelor culturale. Un alt pilon economic important este logistica și industria grea, Pratteln funcționând ca un nod de transport strategic în regiunea celor trei frontiere. Z7 Concert Factory a făcut Pratteln cunoscut la nivel internațional ca o Mecca pentru concertele rock și heavy metal, atrăgând fani din întreaga Europă. În ciuda dezvoltării urbane intense, comuna a păstrat zone verzi precum râul Lörzbach și dealurile împădurite de pe Adlersberg. Trecutul roman al regiunii prinde viață în situl arheologic din apropiere, Augusta Raurica, aflat parțial pe teritoriul comunei Pratteln. În ultimele decenii, imaginea orașului s-a schimbat semnificativ prin clădiri moderne înalte și noi cartiere rezidențiale, transformând Pratteln într-un spațiu de locuit versatil și urban. Diversitatea socială și viața asociativă activă contribuie substanțial la gradul ridicat de identificare al locuitorilor cu orașul lor.
descriptionAdvanced.en: Pratteln is located in the Ergolz Valley east of Basel and marks the transition between the urban agglomeration and the rural surroundings of the Tafeljura. The municipality looks back on impressive industrial development, fueled by early connection to the railway network and the exploitation of salt deposits in the Rhine saltworks. In the historic village center stands Pratteln Castle, a stately 13th-century manor that now serves as a landmark and cultural venue. Another economic pillar is logistics and heavy industry, with Pratteln functioning as a strategically important transport hub in the tri-national border region. The Z7 Concert Factory has made Pratteln internationally famous as a Mecca for rock and heavy metal concerts, attracting fans from all over Europe. Despite strong structural development, the municipality has preserved green lungs such as the Lörzbach stream and the forested hills of the Adlersberg. The region's Roman past comes alive in the nearby Augusta Raurica excavation site, which partly lies on Pratteln's municipal territory. In recent decades, the townscape has changed significantly through modern high-rises and new residential quarters, making Pratteln a versatile and urban living space. Social diversity and an active club life contribute significantly to the high identification of residents with their hometown.
